body.statement:
For a member of \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PNHZ}}\) satisfying the query-local first-jet-determining and fibre-coherence hypotheses, and for distinct current vertices \(u,v\in V_\ell\) with nonempty parent sets,
\[
\rho_\ell(\{u,v\},V_\ell\setminus\{u,v\})\leq1
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
\operatorname{Pa}_G(u)=\operatorname{Pa}_G(v)=\{h\}
\]
for some \(h\in V_{\ell+1}\).  Every such pair query is in \(\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\).  Consequently the nontrivial connected components of \(\sim_\ell\) are exactly the pure blocks \(B_h\).
body.justification: On the strict query-regular subclass, one query per pair replaces exhaustive pure-child subset search.
body.gap: The same-parent upper implication requires the repaired separator lemma; only the different-parent private-path lower implication is unchanged-class once the query is stable.
body.consumer: The regularized reconstruction theorem uses the recovered nontrivial components as the next latent layer.
